header.title: Microcosm — Artificial Life
header.subtitle: An emergent predator–prey ecosystem; each creature has a tiny genome. Explore with mouse wheel and Ctrl+drag.

hook.twoValue: Ctrl = feed | Shift = toxin | Alt = predator

shell.presentationBody: A predator–prey ecosystem where every creature carries a tiny genome. Watch populations evolve, then intervene directly in their environment.
shell.presentationHint: The simulation keeps running behind this panel.

explore.title: Explore
explore.body: Zoom in and roam freely across the ecosystem.

observe.title: Observe
observe.body: Select a cell and follow its lineage.

shell.canvasLabel: Interactive Microcosm simulation. Use the mouse wheel to zoom and drag to move around.

help.worldFriction: Global friction coefficient. Closer to 1 = fluid, inertial motion; lower = tighter movements
help.mutationRate: Probability a child mutates (color, size, speed, sense, efficiency). Higher = diversity/chaos; lower = stable lineages
help.metabolism: Energy cost per tick. Higher = hungrier creatures, faster cycles. Lower = contemplative universe
help.trailFade: Background fade opacity. Low = long smooth trails. High = crisp rendering (few traces)
help.foodCount: Target amount of circulating food. Higher = abundant ecosystem (population booms). Lower = selective pressure
help.foodValue: Energy granted by each food resource. Higher = populations grow faster
help.splitThreshold: Energy required to divide (reproduce). Higher = rarer reproduction, sturdier lineages
help.reproductionCost: Energy cost of division. Higher = parents exhaust themselves reproducing
help.predAttackDamage: Damage dealt by a predator bite. Higher = prey felled faster
help.predAttackCooldown: Frames between two bites. Lower = more frequent attacks
help.predAttackRange: Contact range for a bite to connect (around bodies)
help.predLifesteal: Share of damage converted into energy for the predator (melee survival)
help.herdDefenseCount: Herbivores near the predator required to trigger mobbing
help.herdDefenseDamage: Damage per tick dealt to the predator by the group (scales with stacks)
help.herdDefenseRange: Range at which herbivores are counted as defenders
help.herdDefenseMaxStacks: Maximum additional tiers above threshold (caps herd lethality)
help.socialFollowDuration: Duration a child follows its parent after birth (in ticks)
help.socialFollowStrength: Strength of the force pulling a child toward its parent
help.socialRebelProb: Chance a child ignores parental follow
help.toxinInfectProb: Tick-based chance to get infected inside a toxin zone
help.infectionDuration: How long an organism stays infected before recovering
help.infectionNaturalImmunityRate: Share of newborns with innate immunity
help.infectionExtraDrain: Additional energy drain suffered while infected
help.infectionTransmitRadius: Neighbourhood radius used to spread infection
help.infectionR0: Approximate target R0. Higher = aggressive spreading
help.toxinProximityDrain: Energy drain applied near a toxin (scaled by strength)
help.toxinDigestMultiplier: Energy retained from food while inside a toxin zone (0 = none, 1 = untouched)
